original_test_intent: Verify every expected NVSwitch and GPU-facing NVLink fabric edge appears with correct identity, firmware, port/peer mapping, state, speed/width and health/error properties.
original_method: Pin NVSM build; preserve diagnostics; load switch serial/ID/firmware/port-to-GPU/link topology manifest; run exact `nvsm show nvswitches` read-only; retain raw hierarchy/properties/counters/status; compare node/edge completeness and per-link state, including disabled/unused ports; correlate errors without resetting fabric.
manual_activity: GPU/fabric owner supplies expected NVSwitch/NVLink topology and dispositions every missing, miswired or degraded link.
required_inputs: Expected link state/speed/width/error and unused-port policy
safety_requirements: Never clear logs, reset NVSwitches or retrain links

independent_technical_reasoning: NVSwitch presence does not establish that every port reaches the intended GPU at the correct link state. Node/edge topology and per-port properties are both required because one failed link may be masked by alternate fabric paths.
